line: Offer directions to someone who looks lost.
paragraph: A young fox cub lay hurt on a road in Nottinghamshire, England last June. His back legs would not work after a car struck him. Someone passing by found him. The cub, called Chance, went to a rescue that used water therapy. He learned to swim so his legs could grow strong again. Day by day he moved more freely in the warm pool. He is walking now because a stranger stopped to help.
